title: Agent model picker: OpenRouter model list is not sorted alphabetically
description: FIXED. The Agent chat OpenRouter model picker listed models in raw /models API order. Root cause + fix in packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/openrouterClient.ts parseOpenRouterModels(): after collecting the trimmed OpenRouterModel[] it now models.sort() alphabetically by display name (m.name) case-insensitively/locale-aware (localeCompare with sensitivity:'base') with m.id as a stable tiebreak. Sorting in the parser (not the AgentSettings.tsx render) means ALL consumers get the ordering and no call site re-sorts; AgentSettings.tsx load.models.map(...) needs no change and the '— select a model —' placeholder option (outside the map) stays first. TEST: updated packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/openrouterClient.test.ts — the stale 'skips malformed entries' assertion (encoded raw order) now sorts before comparing; added two tests: 'returns the models sorted alphabetically by display name' (asserts the SAMPLE catalog comes back claude < meta/llama-3 < gpt-4o AND non-descending case-insensitive) and 'sorts case-insensitively and breaks name ties stably by id'.
